reason: The original says the auk slides better than the speaker. The rewrite has the speaker claim to slide better than the listener.
The original says the rain went up and took the hat with it. The rewrite says the rain picked up, which loses the upward rain.
The rewrite pastes the speaker label Smith's boy into the spoken text.
The rewrite pastes the speaker label Smith's boy into the spoken text.
The original item is a periwinkle horn, the catching tool. The rewrite calls it a sea shell.
The original sign says Fall is to the south. The rewrite drops the town and says the fields slope south.
The original is the shell a hole left behind. The rewrite reverses it into a hole left by a shell.
The original says the whorl ate part of the shop counter. The rewrite says it took the speaker's change.
The original says the speaker does not ask questions and charges extra for asking. The rewrite says the speaker makes no demands, which loses the point.
The original says it makes your team go round quicker, a speed hint. The rewrite says it makes your world spin faster.
The rewrite invents a buoy register that is active, which reads as nonsense and drops that the whorl came off a buoy.
The original says this is a wolf's cast. The rewrite reads cast as a verb and says it is like a wolf casting.
The original whorl is a leech. The rewrite says the item comes with a leech attached.
The original says the whorl strikes the same place twice. The rewrite makes lightning the subject, which loses the two-hit hint.
The original names Tack, a person. The rewrite reads the name as an ordinary word with The tack's cast.
The original describes a lugworm shell with a face at each end whose halves come back. The rewrite describes a broken cowrie shell instead.
The original keel comes off the dry sea. The rewrite says it comes off dry land.
The original says the shot lands where you will be by then, a delayed hit. The rewrite says it lands where you are.
The original says you hit what the foam holds and the foam keeps the bill. The rewrite has the foam do the hitting and pay the bill.
The original says nobody near the pew goes all the way down while it sits in play. The rewrite says while it is occupied, as if someone sits on it.
The original says the reliquary keeps a piece of whatever it puts down. The rewrite says it takes a piece of what you set down.
The original says the beetle hits you on its way out of its holes. The rewrite says it strikes when you leave.
The original says hand it a notion, the held item. The rewrite says give it a thought.
The original says this is a musk ox's cast. The rewrite calls it a shed antler, which drops the game term and gives an ox antlers.
The original says the icicle still melts a little when the person it loves passes. The rewrite drops who makes it melt, so the line loses its point.
The original says do not shake hands on the deal. The rewrite says do not shake the whorl.

The original uses the game term low water. The rewrite changes it to low tide.
The original price is five cowries or one of itself, meaning one such purse. The rewrite says five cowries or one, which reads as one cowrie.
The original says high water. The rewrite says high tide and sets them down for the single Auger.
The original says the air got a shell and kept pushing. The rewrite says the speaker got a shell.
The original says the jet breathes things away, mostly the stall. The rewrite says it pushes things toward the stall.
The original says nothing near it moves. The rewrite says silence reigns, which changes stillness into silence.
